model_scope: Complete controller/estimator/reference/guard RTL, M05 domain-parameter stress extrapolation. These domain fits have short prediction windows and are not validated full-angle physical plants. No integer CPU substitute, no future truth in controller, no hardware/STA guarantee. Optional event is a declared instantaneous angular-velocity impulse at first capture+6000ms; no measured human force was identified. Disturbed falls do not count as pre-event spontaneous failures. First and recovered phases reported separately. Automatic down-start, fixed 6000ms sine-on / 12000ms sine-off / configured zero time; no quiet/readiness wait in test harness. This is a mode/commit contract stress test, not a validated nonlinear sine-performance prediction.
